questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “IoT security and updates”?
options: Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
Verifying a firmware signature and version policy before installation is part of a trust chain.
questions.answer: Verifying a firmware signature and version policy before installation is part of a trust chain.
questions.explanation:
Verifying a firmware signature and version policy before installation is part of a trust chain.
Why: Plan least functionality, authentication, encrypted transport, signed firmware, and secure updates. Test recovery to a known-good version if an update fails.
